factors.label: Autocar
factors.note: Per passenger-km, diesel coach ('Autocar thermique'). Impact CO2 assumes an average of 30 passengers per coach. Underlying source shown by Impact CO2: Base Empreinte ADEME.

factors.label: TER
factors.note: Per passenger-km, French national average for regional trains (TER), not specific to liO Occitanie. Underlying source shown by Impact CO2: Base Empreinte ADEME. Train occupancy comes from operator data that Impact CO2 does not publish.

factors.default_occupancy_source: Occupancy requested from the API (occupencyRate=1, its documented default, https://impactco2.fr/doc/api): one person per car. No sourced average occupancy is used; callers may pass their own.
factors.label: Voiture
factors.note: 'Voiture thermique' (Impact CO2 default: medium diesel car), requested with one person on board, so the figure is per vehicle-km: divide by the number of people in the car (driver included) to get a per-passenger figure. Underlying source shown by Impact CO2: 'Modélisation de l'empreinte carbone de la voiture - 2025'.

source.name: ADEME, Impact CO2
source.scope: Usage (fuel or electricity) plus construction of the vehicle (includeConstruction=1). Construction and maintenance of roads, tracks and stations are not included.
source.unit: g CO2e per km (per passenger, or per vehicle when basis is vehicle_km)
